abstract: We assume that lottery participants are poor relative to their target income. Reference dependence with loss aversion can render the marginal utility of income non-monotonic in line with the Friedman–Savage hypothesis. As a result, lottery participation can be rationalized without invoking probability weighting. The theoretical implications align with recent empirical evidence on lottery spending.
abstract_zh: 我们假设彩票参与者相对于其目标收入而言较为贫困。基于损失厌恶的参照依赖可能导致收入边际效用非单调，这与弗里德曼-萨维奇假说相符。因此，无需借助概率加权即可合理化彩票参与行为。理论推论与近期关于彩票支出的实证证据相一致。
title: Reference dependence and lottery participation

abstract: We examine innovation in an n -player market-entry timing game with complete information and observable actions. In our novel multi-player setup, we allow for heterogeneous payoffs between players and leader payoff functions to be multi-peaked and non-monotonic, only requiring that followers’ payoffs are non-increasing with the time of the leader’s entry. We outline the conditions under which an n -player asymmetric game leads to standard second-mover advantage and preemption equilibria. In the context of a two-player game, we provide a comprehensive characterization of the pure-strategy equilibria for a general case. This includes the potential for the emergence of a new type of preemption equilibrium, as well as scenarios where no equilibria in pure strategies exist. Finally, we connect our findings to various applications, offering a new explanation for entry clustering among heterogeneous players
abstract_zh: 我们考察了一个在完全信息且行动可观察的n人市场进入时机博弈中的创新问题。在我们新颖的多参与者设定中，我们允许参与者之间的收益异质性，且领导者收益函数可为多峰且非单调的，仅要求追随者的收益随领导者进入时间的推移而非递增。我们概述了n人非对称博弈导致标准后发优势与抢占均衡的条件。在两人博弈的背景下，我们对一般情形下的纯策略均衡进行了全面刻画。这包括新型抢占均衡可能出现的可能性，以及纯策略下不存在均衡的情景。最后，我们将我们的发现与多种应用联系起来，为异质性参与者之间的进入聚集现象提供了新的解释。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
title: General timing games with multiple players
title_zh: 多参与者的广义时机博弈

abstract: International river basins are prone to droughts in some countries and floods in others. Water inflows from upstream neighbors benefit drought-stricken countries but harm flood-stricken countries. As a generalization of two existing river-sharing models (Ambec and Ehlers, 2008; Ambec and Sprumont, 2002), which do not capture the disutility of water inflow, we formulate the river-sharing problem with floods. We provide two characterizations of benefit-function profiles for which the downstream incremental distribution is the unique welfare distribution that satisfies both the upper and lower welfare bounds of river basin countries. We also propose a strategic bargaining process that yields this welfare distribution as a unique subgame-perfect equilibrium.
abstract_zh: 国际河流流域中，部分国家易遭受干旱，而另一些国家则面临洪涝灾害。上游邻国的来水对遭受干旱的国家有益，却对受洪灾影响的国家造成损害。作为对现有两个河流共享模型（Ambec和Ehlers，2008；Ambec和Sprumont，2002）的推广，这些模型未考虑来水带来的负效用，我们构建了包含洪灾情形的河流共享问题。我们给出了效益函数谱系的两种特征刻画，在此条件下，下游增量分配是唯一同时满足流域国家上、下福利界限的福利分配方案。此外，我们提出了一种策略性谈判过程，该过程以唯一子博弈完美均衡的形式实现这一福利分配。
title: River-sharing problem with floods
title_zh: 洪水条件下的河流共享问题

abstract: Since the late 2000s, shocks and crises of various types have led to a revival of state intervention around the world. This paper builds a large firm-level dataset to analyze state ownership of firms in Europe for the period 2002–18. We confirm the underperformance of state-owned enterprises (SOEs) relative to privately-owned enterprises (POEs) found in earlier literature for this recent period for a range of firm-level performance indicators. We also examine the impact of SOEs on POEs. We find that larger SOE presence in an industry is associated with lower productivity growth and lower productivity levels among private firms in that industry, but does not negatively affect industry dynamics in terms of entry and exit. This suggests potential aggregate productivity gains from reallocating resources from SOEs to POEs. Further, we show that employment is more stable and crisis-resistant at SOEs, and that SOEs are a more stable source of downstream input demand for other firms. Leveraging our dataset’s cross-country nature, we find that SOEs are complements to, rather than substitutes for, lower quality institutions.
title: State-owned enterprises in Europe: Firm performance and aggregate effects
title_zh: 欧洲国有企业——企业绩效与总体效应

abstract: This paper examines the impact of upstream deforestation on water coverage and burned area in wetlands. Using a panel dataset of satellite-derived land cover for multiple hydrographic basins, we analyze this relationship in the Brazilian Pantanal from 1985 to 2023. We find that a 1% increase in upstream deforestation reduces water coverage by 0.51% and increases burned area by 0.55% per year. The effect of upstream deforestation on downstream burned area generates an emissions multiplier, as carbon released through deforestation is compounded by emissions from downstream burned area. On average, for each ton of carbon emitted due to deforestation, an additional 0.14 tons are released through downstream fire.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了上游森林砍伐对湿地水域覆盖面积及过火面积的影响。利用涵盖多个水文流域的卫星遥感土地覆盖面板数据，我们分析了1985年至2023年间巴西潘塔纳尔地区这一关系。研究发现，上游森林砍伐每增加1%，每年水域覆盖面积减少0.51%，过火面积增加0.55%。上游森林砍伐对下游过火面积的影响产生了排放乘数效应，因为森林砍伐释放的碳与下游过火产生的排放相互叠加。平均而言，每因森林砍伐排放一吨碳，下游火灾会额外释放0.14吨碳。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, Volume 138
title: Drying the wetland: Water scarcity in the Brazilian pantanal
title_zh: 湿地干涸：巴西潘塔纳尔的水资源短缺

abstract: The skewed Kalman filter (SKF) extends the classical Gaussian Kalman filter by accommodating asymmetric error distributions in linear state-space models. We introduce a computationally efficient method to mitigate the curse of increasing skewness dimensions inherent in the SKF. By analyzing skewness propagation in state-space systems, we develop the pruned skewed Kalman filter (PSKF), which eliminates elements in cumulative distribution functions that do not significantly impact asymmetry beyond a specified threshold. Extensive simulations on univariate and multivariate state-space models validate the PSKF’s accuracy and efficiency. Additionally, we derive the skewed Kalman smoother and its pruned variant, applying them to estimate a New Keynesian DSGE model using US data via standard maximum likelihood and Bayesian MCMC methods. Results strongly favor skewed distributions, particularly for productivity and monetary policy shocks.
abstract_zh: 偏斜卡尔曼滤波器（SKF）通过适应线性状态空间模型中的非对称误差分布，扩展了经典高斯卡尔曼滤波器。我们引入了一种计算高效的方法，以缓解SKF中偏斜维度增加所带来的维数灾难。通过分析状态空间系统中的偏斜传播机制，我们开发了剪枝偏斜卡尔曼滤波器（PSKF），该滤波器在累积分布函数中剔除那些在指定阈值以上对非对称性影响不显著的元素。对单变量和多变量状态空间模型的大量模拟验证了PSKF的准确性和效率。此外，我们推导了偏斜卡尔曼平滑器及其剪枝变体，并将其应用于使用美国数据通过标准最大似然和贝叶斯MCMC方法估计新凯恩斯DSGE模型。结果强烈支持偏斜分布，尤其是对生产率和货币政策冲击而言。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
title: Pruned skewed Kalman filter and smoother with application to DSGE models
title_zh: 剪枝偏斜卡尔曼滤波与平滑器及其在DSGE模型中的应用
